units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(All this stuff’s getting heavy… I’ll dump what I don’t need.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: Everyone’s favorite <style=Important>journalist reporter</style>, Amy Rose, is hot on the scoop!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: I’m heading out, you’ve been fabulously helpful.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Already? Before you go, Espio and I wanted to give you your <style=Important>presents</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: My <style=Important>presents</style>??
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: You’re both too sweet, thank you!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: Hm… Vector, it seems we have more guests.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Amy, there you are!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Have you found any leads yet?
Want to join us in finding clues?

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: Oh? The detective pair needs help from the birthday girl?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… she knows everyone’s allowed to be sassy on their birthday.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: Flattered, but at the pace you two are going, Sonic’s murderer will never get found.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Oh, she’s confident. She must have something up her sleeve.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: This tip is just too juicy to ignore, I’ll see you all around!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: Don’t worry Sonic, I’ll be the one to avenge you. And quick!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: But how are you gonna leave? The door to the next car is locked!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: Oh, you doubt the birthday girl?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: The birthday girl has a master key!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Right right, the birthday girl gets the birthday key.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Of course, it’s a birthday privilege.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Amy
units.sourceText: I'll solve this case before anyone else! Byeee!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: Amy may be hasty, but she’s thorough.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Now, what are you two doin’? Lookin’ mighty suspicious I say!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: I’m the <style=Important>detective</style>, so I <style=Important>can’t be the murderer</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: And I’m, uh…
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Just making sure things go well.
Here to ask if anyone’s hungry.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Things aren’t going… great.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: Not sure if you’ve forgotten, but there was a murder.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: Well I mean, besides that.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Besides murder??
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… my social skills… nonexistent…)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Starved! I’d kill for a chicken parmesan right about now.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Maybe ‘kill’ isn’t the right language to use right now…
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: I’m Vector, the <style=Important>butcher</style>. I’m licensed to handle raw meat!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: And I’m Espio, the <style=Important>poet</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Ah, poetry! A resonant message from poet to reader meant to challenge our delicate perspectives with the most rhythmic of prose.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Can I hear some?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: …sure. Uh…
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText:
Teardrops in the spring,
Can you hear me sing?
La la la la, dee dee dee dee.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: …Was that it?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: I have more if you like.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: <style="Italics">Cherry blossoms in the spring…</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: I’m, uh, satisfied for now, thanks.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(At least he’s rhyming, I suppose…)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: and I are here to establish both of your alibis.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Can you walk us through what happened after Amy had everyone leave the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Oh sure, it’s simple! We just explained this to Amy, actually.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: When we were all sent off, Rouge, Blaze, Shadow, and Sonic all passed through this <style=CarName>library car</style>,
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: ...where Amy told me and Espio to stay.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: I promptly picked a book off the shelf and made myself comfortable.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: Vector got bored, so he left to see what Knuckles was up to in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Yup!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Where was Rouge? We happened to see her lipstick stain on a cup at the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: Rouge came over to the <style=CarName>library car</style>, seemingly looking for something.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: Then she went to search the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: She came back shortly after. We heard her shout “NO WAY” at the brochure stand over there-
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: But she left back to the <style=CarName>casino car</style> before Shadow came through and locked the door.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Wonder what she found? She’s obviously been on the hunt for something…)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: After Rouge left, Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>casino car</style>...
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: Then entered the <style=CarName>library car</style> and locked the door behind him.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(More importantly… Why has Shadow been locking doors?)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, where Knuckles and I were playing games.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: He insisted on showing us up at Super Monkey Ball.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: I got so engrossed by the rolling monkey action, I hardly noticed when Shadow left the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>...
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: ...I guess he walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to the <style=CarName>casino car</style>, again locking the door behind him...
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: ...then returned to the <style=CarName>lounge car</style> where he was meant to be stationed.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: When Vector came back, we realized Knuckles locked the door to the  <style=CarName>saloon car</style>. We were stuck in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: That’s when  the train sped up! We were worried about the bookshelves falling on us, but we got through it alright.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: We sat trapped here until Amy arrived asking questions. She’s the one that told us someone murdered Sonic.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: And, yeah. That’s all that happened.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Hmm… with all these locked doors, it seems Vector or Espio couldn't have left the <style=CarName>library car</style> or the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>…)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Thank you both for your cooperation! We’re just gonna peek around, and we’ll return with any questions.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: If you return with any meat, I’ll chop it up for yah!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: And if you’d like to be serenaded with a poem, I got you covered too.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Thanks guys!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Their alibi’s seem solid enough, but we should still search for clues.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: What we’re looking for is any evidence that <style=Important>proves what they’re saying is true</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(We need to confirm Vector’s reason for leaving his post, and determine if Espio was actually in the <style=CarName>library car</style> reading.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(A tall task, but we can do it!)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: Let’s get to the bottom of this, Tails!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Absolutely!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: Fancy a poem?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: What'll it be?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Can I get a poem about space?
How about a poem about trains?

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText:
I’ve made it up to space
With my beloved antique vase
But a mistake in my haste
Dropped the vase from my embrace
So my antique I must now replace.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: What caused you to drop the vase?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: Don’t read too deeply, it’s just a poem.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(...he hasn’t thought it through, has he.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText:
Locomotive, in motion
I think I lost my lotion
The window shows the ocean
Oh wait, there’s my lotion
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: Uh, thanks.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: I actually really liked that one.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: …Huh?

units.sourceText:
My starved stomach babbled,
Though I ignore the grumbling tummy.
For the eggs I received are scrambled,
When I asked for my eggs sunny.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Oh wow, um. We don’t serve any eggs on the train, though.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: My talent is wasted on you lot.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: <style="Italics">May the breeze drift you towards success.</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: A one sentence poem for you.

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: I may be a butcher, but they confiscated my meat cleaver before getting on the train…
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: You actually tried to bring a knife on the train??
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: I’m a man of authenticity, Tails. Without a knife I’m just a chef in a ketchup-stained apron, not a butcher!

units.sourceText: …hm. But what if I hid the knife?

units.sourceText: Oh yes please, I’m starved!

units.sourceText: and I are here to confirm two things-

units.sourceText: Why Vector left to go play games with Knuckles, and if Espio really was reading in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.

units.sourceText: Oh that’s easy, I got bored.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: …what??
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Espio
units.sourceText: I wasn’t entertaining him enough, it seems. Vector enjoys being social.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Vector
units.sourceText: Plus we were instructed to mingle. I remembered the arcade machine in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, so figured I’d go check it out.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(This seems to line up with the information we gathered with Knuckles.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: What if it was embarrassing?

units.sourceText: If you won’t talk, I have a hunch on what that book might be.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: , could you help me out?
